html:
an Open World Game Set in Sweden during a fictional radioactive zombie apocalypse, An Iraqi Gun Dealer named Abdulaziz finds a supplier named Simon in Malmö, Sweden. in which a forced signage of a binding contract turns a simple gun deal into a nightmare scenario for Abdulaziz.

This game's Movement is heavily inspired by CS:GO's and Half-Life's Source Engine Based Bunnyhopping, I've always loved this type of movement and adapting it to an Open World game was a blast!

Your current Goals?

  • Slay 300 Zombies, and loot them for Scrap and Ammunition, about this Scrap we're gonna talk about later.

  • Loot as many Stashes you can find around the map, with 100 graciously sprinkled upon the land of Malmö.

  • Level your character up with 3 different categories:

    -Extra Speed: Increases Abdulaziz's Air Cap, Causing him to go Faster.

    -Juggernaut: Much faster emergency health output (think Far Cry's health regen).

    -Scrapper: Makes the random piles of Scrap around the map output much more Scrap than usual.

  • Beat the 6 Missions (I mean if you want to, its optional after all) to earn all the XP in the world, and level up even more.

  • Indulge in the Minigames around the map. (fishing, cards.)

  • Buy and Sell in the game's huge market, by using the as said Scrap you can buy everything from bandages to AK's all the way to Electric Snipers.

  • After doing all that, get the hell outta there!

M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth's Features are Almost Endless, of which:

  • Incredibly fast movement.

  • 15+ Weapons and a complex Weapon Jamming system.

  • Level up System.

  • Buying and Selling Guns and Ammunition.

  • 19 Steam Integrated Achievements.

  • Multiple Minigames.

  • MASSIVE map.

  • And most importantly, It's FREE!

So what are you waiting for? Start playing now!
